anshumankumar.net got an A+ on the [Website Carbon Calculator](https://www.websitecarbon.com/website/anshumankumar-net/): cleaner than 93% of pages tested, 0.04 g of CO2 per visit, on sustainable energy. Modeled at 10,000 monthly views (generous, I know), that's about 4.5 kg of CO2 a year.

Jamstack wins again. Prebuilt static files on a CDN means almost nothing to transfer and nothing to compute per request. The cheap option is also the clean one.

If your site is mostly content, try it: pick a static site generator, push to git, deploy to a CDN, then run your URL through the calculator and see how you stack up.

Made a [browser script](https://gist.github.com/anshumankmr/bbbe9a7b77c0efc87869373068a40696) that exports LeetCode submissions to CSV using your existing login. Claude Tasks reads that history to pick problems worth revisiting and new ones to try. Next: a local-first browser extension to automate the export.
